meta_title: Chris's Gardening Services | Tree Surgery Birmingham
meta_description: Chris's Gardening Services in Birmingham. Expert tree surgery, arborist work, and garden maintenance. Same-day quotes available. Call us today.
hero_eyebrow: NPTC Qualified Arborist — Over 15 Years' Experience
hero_subhead: Dangerous trees, overgrown branches, or storm damage? We remove and prune safely. Free site visit and quote within 24 hours.
services_heading: Complete Tree Surgery & Arborist Services Across Birmingham
services_subhead: From dangerous tree removal to routine pruning and stump grinding, we handle every aspect of arborist work with care and expertise.

services.title: Tree Removal
services.desc: Safe felling of dead, diseased, or dangerous trees. We manage site clearance and handle all waste responsibly, leaving your garden clean and ready for replanting.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Pruning
services.desc: Shape overgrown trees and reduce weight from limbs threatening buildings or overhead lines. Improves light, prevents storm damage, and keeps your garden safe.

services.title: Emergency Storm Damage
services.desc: Fallen trees or split limbs blocking your garden or property? We attend same day to make the area safe and remove debris quickly.

services.title: Stump Grinding
services.desc: Remove stumps below ground level so you can use the space again. No mess, no hassle — perfect for replanting or paving over.

services.title: Tree Health & Inspection
services.desc: Professional assessment of diseased or weakened trees. We advise whether treatment, pruning, or removal is needed to protect your home and garden.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Maintenance
services.desc: Keep boundaries neat and healthy with regular cutting and shaping. We also handle overgrown hedges that have got out of hand.

about_pullquote: I take pride in leaving every garden safer and looking better than we found it.
about_para_1: Chris's Gardening Services was established over 15 years ago on a simple principle: treat every tree and every garden with respect. Starting as a one-man operation in Hall Green, we've grown into a fully qualified arborist team trusted by hundreds of Birmingham homeowners and businesses. All our staff are NPTC certified and fully insured — safety and quality are never compromised.
about_para_2: We're not the biggest tree company in Birmingham, but we're the most reliable. Our customers return because we turn up on time, charge fair prices, and leave no mess. Whether it's a dangerous oak threatening your conservatory or a garden overgrown with brambles, we listen to what you need and get the job done right.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Customers Say About Our Tree Work

reviews.text: Had a massive ash tree right over the house that was cracked and dangerous. Chris came round, quoted us fairly, and removed it within three days. No mess, professional job, and his team was friendly and efficient. Won't use anyone else for tree work now.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Called on a Saturday after a storm brought down a limb into our garden. Chris answered the phone himself, came out the same afternoon, and had it all cleared and chipped by evening. Really impressed. Fair price too, no surprise charges.
reviews.author: Jennifer T.

reviews.text: Brilliant service. Overgrown hedges were a nightmare and we'd had quotes from bigger companies asking silly money. Chris's quote was reasonable and the work was done on schedule with no fuss. Would recommend to anyone needing tree or hedge work.
reviews.author: Paul S.
